verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform with AI-assisted features, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence only documents GDPR/CCPA consent management, consent filters, and data-sale opt-out forwarding rules. These are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented opt-out from AI training, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
